biography.plain_text: Liam Kavanagh is a British financier who founded Rockfire Capital in 2009. His Southampton-based investment advisory business arranged investments through which local councils financed solar farms, and his companies included Toucan Energy Holdings. He received dividends before key companies entered liquidation. He resigned as a Rockfire Capital director in 2024.

long_biography.plain_text:
Financier Liam Kavanagh's Rockfire business financed a rooftop solar installation at Rolls-Royce's Bristol factory. Its electricity was supplied directly to the manufacturer under a 25-year purchase agreement, while Belectric handled operation and maintenance. The partners structured the project around onsite consumption as reductions in government incentives weakened the economics of rooftop generation.

Rockfire also acquired an operating solar farm near Swindon in 2016. British Solar Renewables had developed the site on brownfield land belonging to the Science Museum Group. A separate, 15-year electricity purchase agreement with a bank supported the project, whose investors included Warrington, Newham and Thurrock councils.
